'''Naul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] who was present at the [[Jannimak crash site|''Jannimak'' crash site]] in the [[Geothermal Disruption]] area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="Geothermal">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Geothermal Disruption]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> around [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> Unlike several other scientists,<ref name="datapad Cavalz2">{{TORcite|datapad "Research Log: Entry 0147" located in the Geothermal Disruption forward camp|exp=lots|type=other}}</ref> Naul took interest in [[Cavalz|Professor Cavalz]]'s calculations for toxic fume drift. He however expressed concerns about Cavalz's obsessions with rock.<ref name="datapad Naul">{{TORcite|datapad "Personal Research Journal Entry: 039" located in the Geothermal Disruption forward camp|exp=lots|type=other}}</ref> His own research Naul conducted on a bank of a toxic lake overran by [[Skar'kla]], where he instructed [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors to slice [[Jannimak]]'s Reconnaissance Droids to take samples of the acid in the lake.<ref name="Acid Trip">{{TORcite|Acid Trip|Dantooine Crash Site Outpost|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Naul first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> He is sometimes seen without his beard.<ref name="Acid Trip" />
